body.label: Target
body.html: Self and up to two willing allies within 2 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Each target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn and may move 1 unit toward another protected creature; alone, move 1 unit freely.

surges.html: Each target also resists its next 2 units of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
One target reduces its incoming Damage by 1 more.

rider.title: Authority - Formation
rider.html: Spend this Authority when two protected creatures would be separated by forced movement before your next turn: one may follow the other 2 units. Alone, resist 2 units of that movement instead.
